widgets_values:
Analyze the image and identify its primary subject. Generate a list of reverse prompt keywords specifically targeting the identified subject category. Use only relevant descriptive terms separated by commas without explanations. Follow these guidelines:
For human subjects: person, [gender], [age group], body parts (face, hands, etc.), human-related terms (clothing, hair). Example: person,woman,adult,face,hands,shirt,jeans,blonde.
For animals: species name, animal parts (paws, fur), animal-related terms. Example: dog,puppy,whiskers,tail,fur,collar,pet.
For nature elements: landscape type, natural features, weather elements. Example: mountain,forest,river,snow,clouds,rocks.
For products: object type, material, brand-related terms, technical features. Example: shoe,sneaker,leather,laces,sole,logo,stitching.
For architecture: building type, structural elements, architectural styles. Example: skyscraper,window,glass,steel,modern,balcony.
For vehicles: vehicle type, components, mechanical parts. Example: car,sedan,wheels,headlights,license plate,chrome.
For food: dish type, ingredients, food textures. Example: pizza,cheese,tomato,crust,pepperoni,basil.
For abstract subjects: shape descriptors, pattern types, color fields. Example: geometric,circles,lines,gradient,abstract.
If the subject doesn't fit these categories, create specific reverse terms based on its unique characteristics. Exclude non-essential environmental elements unless integral to the subject. Avoid duplicate terms and maintain semantic relevance. Output only the comma-separated keywords without any introductory text or formatting.

Please provide a detailed description of this image. If any characters in the image are familiar to you, such as celebrities, movie characters, or animated figures, please directly use their names. The description should be as detailed as possible, but should not exceed 100 words.
